meta.name: genomic-intelligence
meta.description: Predict regulatory features, gene structure, and expression directly from DNA sequence using Genomic Intelligence's hosted transformer DNA language models — no local GPU or model weights. Six tasks over a REST API and a hosted MCP server (keyless public demo): promoter regions, splice donor/acceptor sites, enhancer activity, chromatin state, sequence-to-expression (log TPM), and de-novo gene annotation, plus a composite find-genes-then-predict-expression workflow. Use when the user has a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants any of these predictions, mentions Genomic Intelligence, genomicintelligence.ai, api.genomicintelligence.ai, or mcp.genomicintelligence.ai.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要进行DNA序列的功能预测
copy.tagline_en: Predict regulatory features and gene expression from DNA sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to predict functional features from DNA sequences

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Genomic Intelligence 的在线 DNA 模型,根据基因名、区域或 FASTA 序列,返回启动子、剪接位点、表达量等预测。计算在远端,本地无需 GPU 或模型权重。
howto.when: 当用户给出基因名、基因组区域或 DNA/FASTA 序列并想要相关预测,或提到 Genomic Intelligence、其网站或 API/MCP 域名时触发。

say.text: 帮我预测 BRCA1 的启动子区域。
say.note: 调用 promoter 任务,返回启动子窗口预测。

say.text: 预测 HBB 基因在 K562 细胞中的表达量。
say.note: 需要精确 9198bp 的 TSS 居中窗口和细胞类型描述。
对应 composite 流程:先找基因再逐个预测表达。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Genomic Intelligence DNA models to predict promoters, splice sites, chromatin state, expression (log TPM), and annotation from a gene symbol, region, or FASTA sequence. Computation is remote; no local GPU or weights needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user supplies a gene symbol, a genomic region, or a DNA/FASTA sequence and wants these predictions, or mentions Genomic Intelligence, its website, or API/MCP domains.

say_en.text: Predict the promoter region of BRCA1.
say_en.note: Returns promoter window predictions via the promoter task.

say_en.text: Predict expression of HBB in K562 cells.
say_en.note: Requires 9,198 bp TSS-centered window and cell-type string.

say_en.text: Find genes in chr11:5,225,000-5,235,000 and predict their expression.
say_en.note: Composite workflow: find genes then predict expression.
